_note: Per-share close is valued as (cached close OR manual_close) x scale_to_base, giving a price in base_currency. LSE ETFs quoted in pence use 0.01; GBP-quoted use 1.0 (the default for any symbol not listed). Non-GBP holdings need an FX factor (e.g. USD->GBP). Verify these against real quotes and update the FX factor / LPLA price periodically — this is a close-price valuation, not live.
